units.source: The 'Warriors of the North' DLC adds a number of company origins to pick from when starting a new campaign. Each of those comes with a flavor introduction, different starting characters, equipment, resources, and special rules for your campaign. Some origins change the game more than others, but most of them impact it from beginning to end. If the 'Beasts & Exploration' DLC is also installed, the Beast Slayers origin can be selected.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: “北境勇士”DLC 增加了多种战团起源，玩家可在开始新战役时选择。每种起源都有各自的故事开场、初始人物、装备、物资和战役特殊规则。有些起源对玩法的改变更大，但大多数都会在整场战役中持续发挥影响。如果同时安装了“野兽与探索”DLC，还可以选择猎兽者起源。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}You are second-in-command in a mercenary company that has been tracking a brigand named Hoggart for some time now. An unexpected turn of events leaves the company in shatters, and you in charge to rebuild it to its former glory.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Inexperienced{/#7}: Recommended for new players as it includes some helpful guidance in the beginning.
units.zh: {#1}你是一支佣兵团的副指挥，战团已经追踪一个叫霍加特的强盗有些时日。一场突如其来的变故使战团几近覆灭，你接过指挥权，肩负起重建战团、重振昔日荣光的重任。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}初出茅庐{/#7}：推荐新玩家选择，开局会提供一些实用指引。

units.source: Starts off with a basic tutorial
Can choose to do the Hoggart mission
units.zh: 可以选择执行讨伐霍加特的任务

units.source: Has access to the {#1}Renown Tutorial{/#1} and {#2}Undead Hoggart{/#2} events
units.zh: 可以触发{#1}声望教程{/#1}和{#2}亡灵霍加特{/#2}事件

units.source: {#1}After years of bloodying your sword for meager pay, you've saved enough crowns to start your very own mercenary company. With you are three experienced mercenaries with whom you've fought side by side in the shieldwall before.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Impatient{/#7}: A quick start into the world, without any particular advantages or disadvantages.
units.zh: {#1}多年来，你为微薄的报酬浴血奋战，如今终于攒够了克朗，得以组建自己的佣兵团。与你同行的，还有三名经验丰富的佣兵，你们曾在盾墙中并肩作战。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}迫不及待{/#7}：迅速开始冒险，没有特定的优势或劣势。

units.source: {#1}You and your small band of mercenaries have done the dirty work of small-time merchants for years, yet you're barely a step above brigands. You want to be bigger than that. You want it all. And the Gilder will reveal to you the way.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Impatient{/#7}: A quick start into the southern part of the world, without any particular advantages or disadvantages.
units.zh: {#1}你和手下这支小小的佣兵团多年来一直替小商人干脏活，混得却只比强盗好一点。你不甘于此。你想要更多，想要一切。而镀金者会为你指明道路。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}迫不及待{/#7}：在世界南部迅速开始冒险，没有特定的优势或劣势。

units.source: You will spawn in the southern part of the map

{#1}You're running a small trading caravan and have most of your crowns invested into trading goods. But the roads have become dangerous - brigands and greenskins lay in ambush, and there's rumors of even worse things out there.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Caravan{/#7}: Start with two caravan hands in your employ.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Trader{/#12}: Get 10% better prices for buying and selling.{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Not a Warrior{/#17}: Start with no renown, and gain renown at only 66% the normal rate.
your brothers start with dissatisfied mood
units.zh: 你的兄弟们开局时心情不满

units.source: {#1}It started as a ragtag militia made up of anyone brave or desperate enough to volunteer for defending their homes, but has grown into a small army. An army that needs to be fed each day. Perhaps the militia's services could be rented out?{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Peasant Army{/#7}: Start with a roster of 12 poorly equipped peasants.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Human Wave{/#12}: Take up to 16 men into battle at once, and have up to 25 in your roster.{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Dirty Peasants{/#17}: Can never hire anyone that isn't a lowborn peasant.
units.zh: {#1}这原本只是一支临时拼凑的民兵队，由那些勇气十足或走投无路、自愿保卫家园的人组成。如今，它已壮大成一支小军队。可这支军队每天都要吃饭。或许可以让民兵们靠受雇作战赚些钱？{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}农民军{/#7}：开局拥有 12 名装备简陋的农民。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}人海战术{/#12}：最多可让 16 人同时参战，战团最多可容纳 25 人。{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}泥腿子{/#17}：只能招募出身低微的农民。
只能招募{#1}低微出身{/#1}的人

units.source: You can still get and keep non-lowborn brothers from random events
units.zh: 仍然可以通过随机事件获得并保留非低微出身的兄弟

units.source: You can take up to {#1}16{/#1} men into battle and have {#2}25{/#2} men in your roster

{#1}For years you've made a decent living by poaching in the local woods, evading your lord's men by being quick on your feet. But pickings have become slimmer and slimmer, and you're faced with a decision - how to make a living when all you know is how to use a bow?{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Hunters{/#7}: Start with a group of three woodsmen.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Expert Scouts{/#12}: You move faster and can always get a scouting report for any enemies near you.{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Travel Light{/#17}: You can carry less items in your company's inventory.
units.zh: {#1}多年来，你在当地林中偷猎，靠着灵活的双腿躲开领主的手下，日子过得还算不错。但猎物越来越少，你不得不作出抉择：除了用弓，你什么都不会，该怎样谋生？{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}猎人{/#7}：开局拥有三名林中好手。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}侦察专家{/#12}：移动更快，并且始终能获得附近敌人的侦察报告。{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}轻装旅行{/#17}：战团物品栏能携带的物品更少。
与最近的贵族家族的关系 {#1}-20{/#1}

units.source: Has only {#1}81{/#1} instead of 99 inventory slots
Has a movement speed of {#1}111{/#1} instead of 105
Can always see the enemy composition in wild locations
units.zh: 始终可以查看野外据点的敌人组成

units.source: Has access to the {#1}Rangers Origin Hunt Food{/#1} event
units.zh: 可以触发{#1}偷猎者起源：狩猎觅食{/#1}事件

units.source: {#1}Oathtakers are knightly warriors beholden not to liege lords, but to the ideals and teachings of their founder, Young Anselm. The order now finds itself in dire straits, and they've turned to you to reverse their fortunes. Can you teach these zealots to become successful mercenaries?{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Paladins{/#7}: Start with two battle-hardened warriors and good equipment.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Oathtakers{/#12}: Sworn to Young Anselm's teachings, you must take oaths that confer various advantages and disadvantages until fulfilled.
units.zh: {#1}立誓者是一群骑士般的战士，他们不效忠封建领主，而是信奉创始人小安塞尔姆的理想与教诲。如今，骑士团陷入困境，转而请你帮助他们扭转命运。你能教会这些狂热信徒如何成为成功的佣兵吗？{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}圣骑士{/#7}：开局拥有两名久经沙场的战士和精良装备。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}立誓者{/#12}：你们宣誓遵循小安塞尔姆的教诲，必须立下誓言。每项誓言在完成前都会带来不同的优势和劣势。

units.source: Start with only 2 brothers, but each has good equipment. One is always {#1}Old{/#1}, level 3 and equipped with {#2}Young Anselm's Skull{/#2} and a {#3}Battle Standard{/#3}
units.zh: 开局只有 2 名兄弟，但都装备精良。其中一人必定具有{#1}年迈{/#1}特性，等级为 3，并装备{#2}小安塞尔姆的头骨{/#2}和一面{#3}战旗{/#3}

units.source: Can only have {#1}18{/#1} brothers in their roster
units.zh: 战团最多只能容纳 {#1}18{/#1} 名兄弟

units.source: Forced to undertake oaths which confer buffs and debuffs as well as rewarding renown
units.zh: 必须立下誓言；誓言会带来增益和减益，并奖励声望

units.source: Cannot take ambitions, meaning certain items such as goblin trophys cannot be gained
units.zh: 无法选择战团抱负，因此无法获得地精战利品等特定物品

units.source: If playing without Blazing Deserts they start with a fully upgraded cart
units.zh: 未安装“烈日沙漠”时，开局便拥有完全升级的货车

units.source: Can get the {#1}Lindwurm Slayer{/#1} for free, as well as an extra {#2}Oathtaker for free{/#2} and a free {#3}Noble Sword{/#3} in {#4}Tree Fort{/#4} event
units.zh: 可以免费招募{#1}屠龙者{/#1}，还可{#2}免费招募一名立誓者{/#2}，并在{#4}树堡{/#4}事件中免费获得一把{#3}贵族长剑{/#3}

units.source: Has access to many events: {#1}Apprentice vs Oathtaker{/#1}, {#2}Bad Reputation{/#2}, {#3}Captured Oathbringer{/#3}, {#4}Oathtaker Joins{/#4}, {#5}Oathtaker Happy with Company{/#5}, {#6}Oathtaker Mistaken Identity{/#6}, {#7}Oathtakers All Oaths Complete{/#7}, {#8}Oathtakers Confrontation{/#8}, {#9}Oathtakers Lore{/#9}, {#10}Oathtakers Noble Contracts{/#10}, {#11}Oathtakers Skull Cracked{/#11} and {#12}Ruined Priory{/#12} events

{#1}For too long have you been dragged from one bloody battle to another at the whim of lords sitting in high towers. Last night, you absconded from camp together with three others. You're dressed like soldiers still, but you're deserters, and the noose will be your end if you stay here for too long.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Deserters{/#7}: Start with three deserters and decent armor, but lower funds and a noble house that wants to hunt you down.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}First to Run{/#12}: Your men always are first to act in the very first round of combat.
units.zh: {#1}高塔上的领主随心所欲，将你们从一场血战赶往另一场血战，这样的日子已经太久了。昨夜，你与另外三人一起逃出了军营。你们依旧穿着士兵的衣服，却已成了逃兵；要是在此逗留太久，等着你们的就是绞索。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}逃兵{/#7}：开局拥有三名逃兵和不错的护甲，但资金较少，还有一个贵族家族要追捕你们。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}先跑为快{/#12}：战斗第一回合，你的人总是最先行动。
与最近的贵族家族的关系 {#1}-100{/#1}

units.source: You can start with pretty decent equipment (For example, three {#1}Mail Hauberks{/#1}, two {#2}Heater Shields{/#2}, {#3}Aketon Caps{/#3}, one {#4}Light Crossbow{/#4}, one {#5}Shortsword{/#5} and one {#6}Hatchet{/#6})
units.zh: 开局可能拥有相当不错的装备，例如三件{#1}长锁甲{/#1}、两面{#2}熨斗形盾{/#2}、{#3}厚衬布帽{/#3}、一把{#4}轻弩{/#4}、一把{#5}短剑{/#5}和一把{#6}短斧{/#6}

units.source: Your men always are first to act in the very first round of combat and you get no mood penalty for retreating from fights
units.zh: 战斗第一回合，你的人总是最先行动，撤退也不会受到心情惩罚

units.source: Each brother is either a heavily (20-40 hp missing) or lightly (5-20 hp missing) injured, as well as some damaged equipment
units.zh: 每名兄弟都带有重伤（损失 20-40 点生命值）或轻伤（损失 5-20 点生命值），部分装备也已受损

units.source: Has access to the {#1}Deserter Origin Volunteer{/#1} event
units.zh: 可以触发{#1}逃兵起源：志愿者{/#1}事件

units.source: Your brothers will get no {#1}mood{/#1} loss after retreating from fights
units.zh: 你的兄弟不会因撤退而降低{#1}心情{/#1}

units.source: {#1}For all your adult life you've been raiding and pillaging in these lands. But with the local peasantry poor as mice, you may want to finally expand into the profitable field of mercenary work - that is, if your potential employers are willing to forgive your past transgressions.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Warband{/#7}: Start with three experienced barbarians.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Outlaws{/#12}: Start with bad relations to most human factions.{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Pillagers{/#17}: You have a higher chance to get any items from slain enemies as loot.
units.zh: {#1}自成年起，你便一直在这片土地上烧杀抢掠。但当地农民已经穷得叮当响，你或许终于该转行，去做利润丰厚的佣兵了——前提是那些潜在雇主愿意原谅你过去的恶行。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}战帮{/#7}：开局拥有三名经验丰富的蛮族。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}亡命之徒{/#12}：初始时与大多数人类阵营关系恶劣。{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}劫掠者{/#17}：击杀敌人后，更有可能缴获其物品作为战利品。

units.source: {#1}-100{/#1} towards the two closest noble houses
units.zh: 与最近的两个贵族家族的关系 {#1}-100{/#1}

units.source: Starts in the north of the map at a freshly raided village
units.zh: 开局位于地图北部一个刚遭劫掠的村庄

units.source: You have a higher chance to get items from slain enemies as loot
units.zh: 击杀敌人后，更有可能缴获其物品作为战利品

units.source: Has access to the {#1}Raiders Origin Redemption{/#1} event
units.zh: 可以触发{#1}劫掠者起源：赎罪{/#1}事件

units.source: Has a higher chance to get the {#1}Barbarian Volunteer{/#1} event
units.zh: 触发{#1}蛮族志愿者{/#1}事件的概率更高

units.source: {#1}Fueled by an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, the Anatomists have spent years dissecting the exoctic and the alien. With social mores dogging their research, however, they've turned to you to form a mercenary company and provide them a new source of fresh specimens.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Anatomists{/#7}: Start with three men and high funds.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Researchers{/#12}: Research the corpses of your fallen foes and gain knowledge to empower your men.{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Not Fighters{/#17}: Your men will never be of confident morale.
units.zh: {#1}在无尽求知欲的驱使下，解剖学者们多年来一直解剖各种珍奇异类。然而，世俗观念始终阻碍着他们的研究。如今，他们请你组建一支佣兵团，为他们开辟获取新鲜标本的途径。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}解剖学者{/#7}：开局拥有三人和充裕资金。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}研究者{/#12}：研究战死敌人的尸体，掌握强化手下的知识。{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}不擅作战{/#17}：你的人士气永远无法达到“斗志昂扬”。

units.source: Your brothers may never be of confident morale, which makes certain traits less undesirable
units.zh: 你的兄弟士气永远无法达到“斗志昂扬”，这会减轻某些负面特性带来的不利影响

units.source: Slaying non human enemies for the first time will yield unique {#1}potions{/#1}
units.zh: 首次击杀各种非人类敌人时，会获得独特的{#1}药剂{/#1}

units.source: Each potion will provide a permanent buff but will make the brother who drank it sick, the sickness will last longer the more potions they have drank
units.zh: 每种药剂都会提供永久增益，但饮用者会生病；饮用过的药剂越多，病情持续的时间就越长

units.source: If a potion is lost or the brother who drank it killed another can be acquired by killing the relevant enemy again
units.zh: 如果药剂丢失，或饮用者死亡，再次击杀对应敌人即可重新获得该药剂

units.source: Begins the game with an apotheosis potion and four ledgers to keep track of what potions you have acquired
units.zh: 开局拥有一瓶超凡药剂，以及四本记录已获得药剂的账册

units.source: Has access to a plethora of events; {#1}Anatomist vs Ailing{/#1}, {#2}Anatomist vs Asthmatic{/#2}, {#3}Anatomist vs Clubfooted{/#3}, {#4}Anatomist vs Dog{/#4}, {#5}Anatomist vs Historian{/#5}, {#6}Anatomist vs Iron Lungs{/#6}, {#7}Anatomist Wants Skull{/#7}, {#8}Anatomist Bummed at Mutations{/#8}, {#9}Anatomist Okay With Mutations{/#9}, {#10}Anatomist Old Patient{/#10}, {#11}Anatomist Creeps Out Locals{/#11}, {#12}Anatomist Dead Knight{/#12}, {#13}Anatomist Exhumes Hero{/#13}, {#14}Anatomist Joins{/#14}, {#15}Anatomist Helps Blighted Guy 1{/#15}, {#16}Anatomist Helps Blighted Guy 2{/#16}, {#17}Anatomist Confronts Healer{/#17}, {#18}Black Market{/#18}, {#19}Killer on the Run Reminisces{/#19}, {#20}Missing Kids{/#20}, {#21}Mutated Gladiator Annoys Others{/#21}, {#22}Something in Barn{/#22} & {#23}Strange Scribe{/#23}
units.zh: 可以触发大量事件：{#1}解剖学者与体弱者{/#1}、{#2}解剖学者与哮喘患者{/#2}、{#3}解剖学者与跛足者{/#3}、{#4}解剖学者与狗{/#4}、{#5}解剖学者与历史学者{/#5}、{#6}解剖学者与铁肺{/#6}、{#7}解剖学者索要头骨{/#7}、{#8}解剖学者因变异而沮丧{/#8}、{#9}解剖学者接受变异{/#9}、{#10}解剖学者的老病人{/#10}、{#11}解剖学者吓坏当地人{/#11}、{#12}解剖学者与死去的骑士{/#12}、{#13}解剖学者掘出英雄{/#13}、{#14}解剖学者加入{/#14}、{#15}解剖学者帮助病人 1{/#15}、{#16}解剖学者帮助病人 2{/#16}、{#17}解剖学者与医师对峙{/#17}、{#18}黑市{/#18}、{#19}在逃杀人犯忆往事{/#19}、{#20}失踪的孩子{/#20}、{#21}变异角斗士惹恼同伴{/#21}、{#22}谷仓异物{/#22}和{#23}奇怪的抄写员{/#23}

units.source: {#1}Davkul awaits. You lead a small flock devoted to the elder god, and it's time to spread the word. Find more followers, acquire riches, and please Davkul with sacrifices.{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Cultists{/#7}: Start with a group of four cultists with poor equipment.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Sacrifices{/#12}: Davkul will occasionally demand sacrifices from you, but also bestow boons upon those loyal to him.
units.zh: {#1}达夫库尔在等待。你带领着一小群信奉这位古老神祇的追随者，如今是时候传播他的教义了。招揽更多信徒，积累财富，以献祭取悦达夫库尔。{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}邪教徒{/#7}：开局拥有四名装备简陋的邪教徒。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}献祭{/#12}：达夫库尔偶尔会要求你献上祭品，也会赐福于忠诚的信徒。
可以获得邪教徒专属特性

units.source: Has access to the {#1}Cultist Origin Armor{/#1}, {#2}Cultist Origin Finale{/#2}, {#3}Cultist Origin Flock{/#3}, {#4}Cultist Origin Hood{/#4}, {#5}Cultist Origin Sacrifice{/#5}, {#6}Cultist Origin vs Old Gods{/#6} and {#7}Cultist Origin vs Uneducated{/#7} event

Is it true still?{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Lone Wolf{/#7}: Start with a single experienced hedge knight and great equipment, but low funds.{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Elite Few{/#12}: Can never have more than 12 men in your roster.{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Avatar{/#17}: If your hedge knight dies, the campaign ends.
units.zh: {#1}你独自旅行了很久，参加比武大会，与年轻贵族切磋武艺。身为一个高大如树的流浪骑士，你从不需要长久依靠任何人。如今还是这样吗？{/#1}{#2/}{#3/}{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}孤狼{/#7}：开局只有一名经验丰富的流浪骑士，装备极佳，但资金较少。{#8/}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}少数精锐{/#12}：战团最多只能容纳 12 人。{#13/}{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}玩家化身{/#17}：如果这名流浪骑士死亡，战役便会结束。

units.source: {#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}The nearest city state is supposed to have an Arena, however, apparently due to a bug, players report that it is not always the case - an Arena is not guaranteed to be spawned.{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}最近的城邦本应有竞技场。不过，玩家反馈并非总是如此，似乎存在一个错误：竞技场不一定会生成。{/#3}

units.source: {#1}Perks{/#1} is a gameplay mechanic associated with the level up system of player's mercenaries. With each new character level reached by your mercenary he will gain 1 Perk point in addition to {#2}Attributes{/#2} stats points.
units.zh: {#1}特长{/#1}是与玩家佣兵升级系统相关的一项游戏机制。佣兵每提升一级，除了获得{#2}属性{/#2}点以外，还会获得 1 点特长点。

units.source: There is a total of 7 Perk rows. To unlock the second perk row, you need to spend one perk point. To unlock the third row you need to spend two perk points. These points can be allocated in any of the unlocked perk rows. So, a player is somewhat forced to pick several perks in the early level up rows till all seven perk rows are unlocked. If a player decides to make some adjustment to perks already chosen, he can reset selected character's perks with a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Potion of Oblivion{/#4}.
units.zh: 特长共分为 7 层。要解锁第二层，需先花费一点特长点；解锁第三层则需先花费两点。这些点数可以分配在任意已解锁的层级。因此，在解锁全部七层之前，玩家必须先在较低层选择一些特长。如果想调整已经选定的特长，可以使用 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}遗忘药剂{/#4}重置指定角色的特长。

units.source: Upon reaching the veteran character level a regular mercenary brother will gain 10 perk points. An extra perk point can only be gained upon using a {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Mysterious Jug{/#4}.
units.zh: 达到老兵等级时，普通佣兵兄弟累计会获得 10 点特长点。此后，只有使用 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}神秘陶壶{/#4}才能再获得一点特长点。

units.source: Every player, who would like to broaden and deepen their knowledge of Perks, is recommended to read the {#1}{#2}In-Depth Perks Guide{/#2}{/#1} by {#3}turtle225{/#3} and {#4}Abel{/#4}. It provides "an up to date guide that deep dives into each perk to help you make educated decisions when building your bros".
units.zh: 推荐想要进一步了解特长的玩家阅读 {#3}turtle225{/#3} 和 {#4}Abel{/#4} 编写的{#1}{#2}特长深入指南{/#2}{/#1}。这是一份持续更新的指南，深入分析每项特长，帮助你在培养兄弟时作出有依据的选择。

units.source: After you read about what each perk does, you can use the {#1}{#2}Battle Brothers Perk Calculator{/#2}{/#1} tool made by {#3}EveryCrime{/#3} or the {#4}{#5}Battle Brothers Planner{/#5}{/#4} tool made by {#6}Unislash{/#6}. They let you visually calculate how you can spend your perk points on a character with a certain level or how you have to progress in order to achieve the perk combinations you want.
units.zh: 了解各项特长的效果后，你可以使用 {#3}EveryCrime{/#3} 制作的{#1}{#2}战场兄弟特长计算器{/#2}{/#1}，或 {#6}Unislash{/#6} 制作的{#4}{#5}战场兄弟规划工具{/#5}{/#4}。这些工具可以直观地帮助你计算某个等级的角色如何分配特长点，以及为了凑出目标特长组合应当怎样逐级培养。

At the start of a new campaign, players can set the economic difficulty and starting funds. The effects of each setting is displayed in the tables below:
units.zh: 开始新战役时，玩家可以选择经济难度和初始资金。各项设置的影响见下表：

units.source: Economic difficulty and resources max values
units.zh: 经济难度与物资数量上限

units.source: A recurring problem, especially in the early game. Sources of income are quite obvious but effectively tapping into them can prove challenging:
units.zh: 这是个反复出现的问题，尤其是在前期。收入来源并不难找，但要充分利用它们，却未必容易：

units.source: To keep hard-earned money it's also important to manage expenses:
units.zh: 想留住辛苦赚来的钱，控制开支也同样重要：

units.source: A main source of income throughout the whole game.
units.zh: 贯穿整个游戏的主要收入来源之一。

units.source: The type variable is set for each contract according to its inherent difficulty. For example, the 'return item' contract has a value of 400 and the 'find artifact' contract has the highest value of 2,000.
units.zh: 每种委托的类型系数由其固有难度决定。例如，“归还物品”委托的数值为 400，而“寻找遗物”委托的数值最高，为 2,000。

units.source: The random modifier is a multiplier between 90% and 110%.
units.zh: 随机修正是介于 90% 和 110% 之间的倍率。

units.source: The difficulty rating gives a random multiplier inside a range. It is then raised to the power of 1.3:
units.zh: 难度评级会在一定区间内给出一个随机倍率，再取该倍率的 1.3 次幂：

units.source: {#1}Renown{/#1} × 0.3% is used as a base raised to the power of 0.39. The result is another multiplier that cannot be lower than 1.35 (720 Renown) nor higher than 2.7 (4,256 Renown). The gains are very high with low Renown values and slowly become almost linear as it grows. There's another formula with smaller benefits but it's only used for a couple contracts ('deliver item' and 'discover location').
units.zh: 以{#1}声望{/#1} × 0.3% 为底数，取其 0.39 次幂，得到另一个倍率。该倍率最低为 1.35（720 声望），最高为 2.7（4,256 声望）。声望较低时，提升声望的收益很高；随着声望增加，收益变化会逐渐接近线性。还有另一套收益较小的公式，但仅用于少数委托（“运送物品”和“发现地点”）。

units.source: Renown has the biggest impact of all modifiers on contract payments so increasing it as quickly as possible should be a priority. Contrary to a popular belief, Renown has no effect on enemy strength but it can be used as a condition for some events. Here's a summary of what affects Renown:
units.zh: 在所有修正因素中，声望对委托报酬的影响最大，因此应优先尽快提高声望。与一种常见说法不同，声望不会影响敌人实力，但有些事件会将其作为触发条件。以下汇总了影响声望的因素：

units.source: Economic difficulty gives yet another multiplier. One contract ('big game hunt') gets an additional multiplier based on the difficulty rating. All delivery contracts also take distance traveled into account.
units.zh: 经济难度还会提供一个倍率。有一种委托（“大型猎物狩猎”）会根据难度评级获得额外倍率。所有运送类委托也会将行程距离计入报酬。

units.source: The short answer is: yes, but well and not too much.
units.zh: 简而言之：应该，但要谈得合适，也别得寸进尺。

units.source: {#1}Negotiations{/#1} offer up to four options (besides accepting an offer or refusing a {#2}contract{/#2} altogether):
units.zh: {#1}谈判{/#1}最多提供四种选项（不包括接受报价或彻底拒绝{#2}委托{/#2}）：

units.source: We need to be paid more for this (no special mode of payment)
units.zh: 这件事得加钱（不指定特殊付款方式）

units.source: We need more payment once the work is done (only available if payment in advance is currently offered and cannot be selected two times in a row)
units.zh: 事成之后得多付一些（仅在当前报价包含预付款时可选，且不能连续选择两次）

units.source: We need to be paid (more) per head we return with (only available for contracts involving kills)
units.zh: 每带回一个人头，得（多）付些钱（仅适用于需要击杀目标的委托）

units.source: Out of these four options, only the first one gives a net gain on payment (for a slight {#1}relations{/#1} penalty of −0.5%). The other options just reallocate an initial sum. It is understandable in the case of an advance because after all, time is money. But the last two modes of payment are basically scams. Better avoid them! For the same reason, it's counterproductive to jump back and forth between modes (and unlikely to work at all) so stick to one.
units.zh: 四个选项中，只有第一个会真正增加报酬，代价是轻微的{#1}关系{/#1}惩罚（−0.5%）。其他选项只是重新分配原有总额。预付款尚可理解，毕竟时间就是金钱；但后两种付款方式基本是陷阱，最好避开。同理，来回切换付款方式只会适得其反，而且很可能根本行不通，因此选定一种就好。

units.source: When attempting to negotiate, the game first checks if the attempt is successful using an 'annoyance' variable. A random number between 3 and 6 is rolled and compared to a maximum tolerance valued at 9. If superior, the negotiations fail, resulting in a relations penalty (−2.5%) with the faction and removing the contract. So it's always safe to negotiate at least once, risky to do it twice (62.5% chance of success without knowing the previous roll), almost impossible to do it thrice and impossible to do it more. Asking for a payment in advance three times in a row (two if it's offered at the start) will always fail.
units.zh: 尝试谈判时，游戏先根据“恼怒度”判断谈判是否失败。每次会抽取一个 3 到 6 之间的随机数，累加后与数值为 9 的容忍上限比较。若超出上限，谈判就会破裂，你与该阵营的关系受到惩罚（−2.5%），委托也会消失。因此，谈一次总是安全的；谈两次就有风险（不知道上次随机数时，成功率为 62.5%）；谈三次几乎不可能成功，再多则必定失败。连续三次要求预付款也一定失败；如果初始报价已有预付款，连续两次要求增加预付款就会失败。

units.source: Even if the negotiation attempt does not fail, there's a chance the employer will refuse new terms. The base chance is 10% × annoyance (the sum of the random rolls).
units.zh: 即使谈判没有破裂，雇主也可能拒绝新条件。基础拒绝概率为 10% × 恼怒度（各次随机数之和）。

units.source: These are the effects in case of a success:

units.zh: 谈判对上一次报价的影响

units.source: various reallocation between completion and advance
units.zh: 在完工款与预付款之间以不同方式重新分配

units.source: Each type of contract has a base value that ranges from 40 to 200. It's multiplied by the other variables.
units.zh: 每种委托都有一个 40 至 200 之间的基础值，再与其他变量相乘。

units.source: The difficulty rating gives a random multiplier inside a range.
units.zh: 难度评级会在一定区间内给出一个随机倍率。

units.source: The roster strength rates the power of the 12 or 14 ({#1}Peasant Militia{/#1} origin) strongest characters in your party. Each character is valued at 10 + (level - 1) × 2. If the party contains less than 3 members, each character whatever his level adds +10 to the strength rating.
units.zh: 队伍实力按战团中最强的 12 名角色计算；{#1}农民民兵{/#1}起源则取 14 名。每名角色的实力值为 10 +（等级 - 1）× 2。如果队伍不足 3 人，无论角色等级如何，每人还会为实力评分额外增加 +10。

units.source: The following formula is used to calculate the final multiplier: 94% × (1% × roster strength) ^ 0.89. It cannot be lower than 0.75 (78 strength or about 8 level 1 characters) or higher than 5 (654 strength or about 12 level 21 characters). The result is then multiplied by the combat difficulty:
units.zh: 最终倍率按以下公式计算：94% ×（1% × 队伍实力）^ 0.89。倍率最低为 0.75（78 实力，大约相当于 8 名 1 级角色），最高为 5（654 实力，大约相当于 12 名 21 级角色）。结果再乘以战斗难度倍率：

units.source: The roster strength is potentially the most impactful variable. That's why some people recommend keeping a low number of men to reduce the difficulty of contracts. Each additional level 1 character before 12 or 14 (Peasant Militia origin) is worth 6 levels in strength.
units.zh: 队伍实力可能是影响最大的变量。因此，有些玩家建议控制人数，以降低委托难度。在人数未达到 12 人（农民民兵起源为 14 人）之前，每增加一名 1 级角色，实力评分的增量相当于提升 6 级。

units.source: The maximum number and type of enemies is limited by the spawn list used (the difficulty doesn't scale indefinitely).
units.zh: 敌人的最大数量和种类还受到所使用的生成列表限制，因此难度不会无限增长。

units.source: {#1}Trade{/#1} consists in buying goods to sell them at a profit. Trade potential is directly linked to a map layout (settlements and attached locations, terrain and roads) which makes it an unreliable source of income. The {#2}Trading Caravan{/#2} origin improves trade profitability by giving better prices. Trade itself is (finances put aside) risk-free and as such quite useful in the early game when recruits, equipment and other sources of income are still weak.
units.zh: {#1}贸易{/#1}就是买入商品，再卖出赚取差价。贸易潜力与地图布局直接相关，包括定居点及其附属设施、地形和道路，因此并非稳定可靠的收入来源。{#2}贸易商队{/#2}起源能获得更好的价格，提高贸易利润。贸易本身除了资金方面的问题，并没有其他风险，因此在前期新兵、装备和其他收入来源都还薄弱时尤其有用。

units.source: {#1}Trade goods{/#1} sell for their full worth (instead of 95% for {#2}Treasures{/#2} and 15% for other items). But they are still subjected to prices variations. Obviously, bigger profits come from buying cheap, discounted goods and selling them at a premium rate. For each {#3}settlement{/#3}, prices are affected by:
units.zh: {#1}贸易商品{/#1}按完整价值出售，而{#2}珍宝{/#2}的基准售价为价值的 95%，其他物品则只有 15%。不过，贸易商品仍会受到价格波动影响。想赚得更多，自然要低价买入，再以较高价格卖出。每座{#3}定居点{/#3}的价格受以下因素影响：

units.source: Type of attached locations (trade goods locally produced or not)
units.zh: 附属设施类型（贸易商品是否为本地出产）

units.source: The base price multiplier is defined by the settlement level:
units.zh: 基础价格倍率由定居点等级决定：

units.source: To that value is added the number of attached locations × 3%. This number ranges from 3 to 8 (9-24%). It is therefore best to buy in small villages with few attached locations and sell in large developed cities.
units.zh: 在该数值上再加上“附属设施数量 × 3%”。设施数量介于 3 至 8 之间，对应 9-24%。因此，最好在附属设施较少的小村庄购买，再到发展完善的大城市出售。

units.source: Another number based on relations with the settlement (0-100) is added or subtracted to the base multiplier:
units.zh: 与定居点的关系值（0-100）还会决定一个加减修正，作用于基础倍率：

units.source: Relations < 50: ± (50 − relations) × 0.6% for a range of 0-30% (added if buying, subtracted if selling)
units.zh: 关系 < 50：±（50 − 关系）× 0.6%，范围为 0-30%（购买时加上，出售时减去）

units.source: Relations > 50: ± (relations − 50) × 0.3% for a range of 0-15% (subtracted if buying, added if selling)
units.zh: 关系 > 50：±（关系 − 50）× 0.3%，范围为 0-15%（购买时减去，出售时加上）

units.source: Negative relations are doubly as penalized as positive relations are rewarded. Seemingly, civilian relations is what counts for towns, noble relations for fortifications.
units.zh: 关系不佳带来的惩罚，是关系良好所获优惠的两倍。看起来，城镇使用平民关系，军事要塞则使用贵族关系。

units.source: Settlement types and their locations as well as your relations with them have the biggest impact on prices. So it's a good idea to leverage these variables as much as possible to maximize profits. Situations can also greatly affect prices. Some multiply all prices while others just target a specific price or item type prices (see their page for details).
units.zh: 定居点类型、附属设施以及你与当地的关系，对价格影响最大。应尽量利用这些因素来提高利润。当地状况也可能大幅影响价格：有些状况会同时调整所有价格，有些则只影响特定价格或某类物品的价格，详情参见对应页面。

units.source: Trade goods prices differ depending on whether or not they are produced in the settlement:
units.zh: 贸易商品是否为本地出产，也会影响价格：

units.source: This reflects the supply and demand economic model. If the location is destroyed, the goods are considered not produced anymore.
units.zh: 这反映了供求关系。如果相关附属设施被摧毁，该商品就不再视为本地出产。

units.source: Overall, Beast Slayers will make 20% less money with trade while the Trading Caravan will make 20% more.
units.zh: 总体而言，猎兽者通过贸易赚到的钱会减少 20%，贸易商队则会多赚 20%。

units.source: The economic difficulty only modifies selling prices (90% for expert).
units.zh: 经济难度只会调整售出价格，专家难度为 90%。

units.source: Shops resupply every 3 days but {#1}situations{/#1} can force a restock.
units.zh: 商店每 3 天补货一次，但{#1}当地状况{/#1}也可能触发库存刷新。

units.source: Player Drathnar has an interesting view on {#1}trade{/#1}:
units.zh: 玩家 Drathnar 对{#1}贸易{/#1}有一番值得参考的看法：

units.source: {#1}I generally don't really find it that profitable to do trading just for trading's sake, unless your map has lots of places producing trade goods.Yes, you'll make some gold, but you also need to deduct daily wage and food expenses for the men for the time you need to travel to a proper city hall to sell those goods. Also very occasionally there are unfavorable settlement situations at your destination and no ready contract to clear them, which can really put a dent in one's plans for trade.{#2/}So usually what I do is I plan my next destination according to contracts I can pick up. But I do buy any trade goods in town which are cheap. Hopefully at some point, when I visit a City Hall settlement, I'll dump all my items and goods there.{/#1}{#3}{#4}{#5}[{/#5}1{#6}]{/#6}{/#4}{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}一般来说，我觉得专程跑商并没有多大利润，除非地图上有很多地方生产贸易商品。的确，你能赚到些钱，但把货物运到合适的市政厅定居点出售需要时间，这期间兄弟们的日薪和食物开销都得扣掉。偶尔，目的地还会出现不利的当地状况，又恰好没有能解决它的委托，这会严重打乱跑商计划。{#2/}所以，我通常会根据能接到的委托来安排下一站。不过，只要城里的贸易商品便宜，我还是会买下来。希望之后哪次经过有市政厅的定居点时，能把手头的物品和货物一并卖掉。{/#1}{#3}{#4}{#5}[{/#5}1{#6}]{/#6}{/#4}{/#3}

units.source: He follows up on the importance of managing inventory space to maximize earnings and avoid opportunity costs:
units.zh: 他还强调，要提高收益并避免机会成本，管理物品栏空间十分重要：

units.source: {#1}As you progress through the game, foes will drop better gear and the benefit of trade goods needs to be compared whether it is worth occupying that slot. For example, you might buy Peat Bricks at 111G and sell for 131G at a City Hall, but if you're killing enough brigands and getting good loot, having that slot for say an extra Hatchet that you would have otherwise discarded would net you 37G extra gold. And Hatchets are of course just tier 1 weapons. If missing out on tier 2 weapons, the opportunity cost would be much larger.{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}1{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}随着游戏推进，敌人掉落的装备越来越好，你就得比较贸易商品的利润是否值得占用一个栏位。例如，你可能以 111 克朗买入泥炭砖，再到有市政厅的地方卖出 131 克朗。但如果你杀了很多强盗、获得了不错的战利品，把这个栏位留给原本不得不丢弃的那把短斧，就能额外赚到 37 克朗。而短斧还只是 1 阶武器；如果错失的是 2 阶武器，机会成本就更大了。{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}1{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}

units.source: Looting is the process of attacking parties or locations for spoils. {#1}Treasures{/#1} can be used or sold:
units.zh: 搜刮战利品，就是进攻队伍或据点以夺取财物。取得的{#1}战利品{/#1}可以自用，也可以出售：

units.source: All items but trade goods (see the {#1}Trade{/#1} section) sell for a fraction of their worth:
units.zh: 除贸易商品外（参见{#1}贸易{/#1}章节），所有物品的基准售价都只是其价值的一部分：

units.source: In effect, for a same base value, 1 treasure is worth roughly 6 items. To the exception of the Lindwurm's Hoard which slain {#1}Lindwurms{/#1} sometimes reward, treasure can only be found in locations. {#2}Tavern rumors{/#2} can mention a location containing treasure.
units.zh: 因此，在基础价值相同的情况下，1 件珍宝的售价大约抵得上 6 件其他物品。除击杀{#1}林德蠕龙{/#1}偶尔获得的蠕龙宝藏外，珍宝只能在据点中找到。{#2}酒馆传闻{/#2}可能会提到藏有珍宝的据点。

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}Should I repair damaged equipment before selling it?{/#3}{/#2}

Selling {#1}Treasures{/#1} can be more or less rewarding depending on its type and worth, the settlement where it is sold (see {#2}How can I increase trade profitability?{/#2}). But the selling price of an item also depends, if it has any, on its durability. It means that {#3}weapons{/#3}, {#4}shields{/#4}, {#5}armor{/#5} and {#6}helmets{/#6} will sell for more if they're undamaged. To repair an item hold ALT and right click it.
units.zh: 出售{#1}战利品{/#1}的收益，会因其种类、价值及出售地点而有所不同（参见{#2}如何提高贸易利润？{/#2}）。对于有耐久度的物品，售价还受到耐久度影响。因此，完好的{#3}武器{/#3}、{#4}盾牌{/#4}、{#5}护甲{/#5}和{#6}头盔{/#6}能卖得更贵。按住 ALT 并右键点击物品，即可将其设为修理。

units.source: Each {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} unit repairs 15 durability. Assuming a same {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} price, there are thus two parameters to account for in the calculation:

The following table shows a list of equipment. The 'W/D' row represents worth per unit of durability. The 'W/20T@17%' row represents the return on a 20 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} stack investment for repairing and selling the item at 17% of its worth (default average selling price modifier in large settlements for expert economic difficulty). Values that are higher than what a 20 {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} stack costs are a profit. Items with a very low return, that is a W/D of less than 5 were removed from the table.
units.zh: 下表列出各类装备。“W/D”表示每点耐久对应的价值。“W/20T@17%”表示投入一整组 20 单位 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} 修理装备，再按价值的 17% 出售时获得的回款；这是专家经济难度下大型定居点的默认平均售价倍率。回款高于一组 20 单位 {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} 的成本，就有利润。回款很低的物品，即 W/D 小于 5 的物品，已从表中剔除。

units.source: Loot Worth per Durability & Return on investment
units.zh: 战利品每点耐久的价值与修售收益

units.source: Decayed Closed Flat Top With Mail
As can be seen from the data, weapons are the most profitable items to repair. They are followed by armor and then helmet. A {#1}Boar Spear{/#1} has the same return than a {#2}Full Helm{/#2}!
units.zh: 从数据可以看出，修理后出售最划算的是武器，其次是护甲，再其次是头盔。一把{#1}猎猪矛{/#1}的修售收益，竟然与一顶{#2}全罩盔{/#2}相同！

units.source: This table shows that attacking targets like {#1}Orcs{/#1}, {#2}soldiers{/#2}, {#3}mercenaries{/#3} or in general any {#4}faction{/#4} with high tier equipment is well worth it in terms of loot value. {#5}Beasts{/#5} carry no equipment and will only leave {#6}Trophies{/#6} that can be sold or used as crafting components.
units.zh: 这张表说明，单看战利品价值，进攻{#1}兽人{/#1}、{#2}士兵{/#2}、{#3}佣兵{/#3}，以及任何拥有高级装备的{#4}阵营{/#4}，都很值得。{#5}野兽{/#5}没有装备，只会留下可供出售或制作物品的{#6}战利材料{/#6}。

units.source: Undamaged loot does not need repairing. In that case, worth is the only parameter determining profitability which benefits armor and helmets. That's why successfully retrieving undamaged armor from enemies is very rewarding. That can be done for both armor and helmets by using {#1}daggers{/#1} Puncture, a skill that completely ignores armor. And to retrieve armor only, by using {#2}flails{/#2} Lash, a skill that directly targets the head.
units.zh: 完好的战利品无需修理，此时决定收益的唯一因素就是价值，这对护甲和头盔更有利。因此，成功缴获敌人的完好护甲收益很高。想同时保住身体护甲和头盔，可以使用{#1}匕首{/#1}的破甲刺击，该技能完全无视护甲。若只想保住身体护甲，则可以用{#2}连枷{/#2}的鞭打技能直接攻击头部。

units.source: Items that belonged to slain enemies are not always found as loot. There are several conditions for an item to drop:
units.zh: 被击杀敌人的物品不一定会成为战利品。物品掉落需要满足若干条件：

units.source: Not in the bag (enemy throwing weapons)
units.zh: 未放在背包中（适用于敌人的投掷武器）

units.source: Belonged to the player or an enemy (not an ally) killed by the player
units.zh: 原属玩家，或原属被玩家击杀的敌人，而非友军

units.source: The {#1}Northern Raiders{/#1} origin gives an additional 15% chance to loot items even if some of the conditions aren't met (varies with the item type). If the item belonged to the player, durability conditions can be reduced or removed and there's no roll. {#2}Named and Legendary Items{/#2} always drop. A bug will sometimes prevent armor (and maybe other items) from being awarded even if the conditions were met. If a looted item that cannot be swapped in battle (armor) has more than 66% of its maximum durability, there's a 50% chance that its durability will be set to a value comprised between the durability and 35% of the maximum durability.
units.zh: {#1}北境劫掠者{/#1}起源额外提供 15% 的物品缴获概率，即使部分条件不满足也可能掉落，具体因物品类型而异。如果物品原属玩家，耐久要求可能降低或取消，并且无需随机判定。{#2}红装与传奇装备{/#2}必定掉落。有时某个错误会导致护甲（也可能包括其他物品）即使满足条件仍不掉落。如果缴获的物品无法在战斗中更换（如护甲），且剩余耐久超过上限的 66%，则有 50% 的概率将其耐久改为当前耐久与上限 35% 之间的一个值。

units.source: Enemy weapons can apparently be more or less damaged at the start of a battle but they never lose durability during battle (and never break). It's always possible to know, after having killed its owner, if an item was destroyed or not by checking what has been left on the ground. If the item is there, it will show up as loot at the end of a successful battle (unless it was picked from the ground).
units.zh: 敌人的武器在开战时似乎可能已有不同程度的损坏，但战斗中不会继续损失耐久，也不会损毁。击杀持有者后，可以查看地上留下的物品，判断装备是否已毁。只要物品还在地上，获胜后就会出现在战利品中，除非它已被人从地上拾起。

units.source: {#1}Events{/#1} can also reward loot, for example:
units.zh: {#1}事件{/#1}也可能奖励战利品，例如：

units.source: Cutting expenses is another reliable way to stay financially healthy. But some expenses are hard to reduce. There are two main sources of expenses:
units.zh: 削减开支也是保持财务稳健的可靠办法，但有些开支很难压缩。主要开支分为两类：

units.source: Purchases cover everything that's bought from {#1}Supplies{/#1} to other items like {#2}Weapons{/#2} and {#3}Armor{/#3} and upfront payment (which depends on {#4}Level{/#4} and equipment) for recruits. That first item of expenditure is highest in the early game when fresh members need equipment. That is when investing ensures that you will not otherwise spend more later.
units.zh: 采购开支包括购买{#1}补给{/#1}、{#2}武器{/#2}、{#3}护甲{/#3}等物品，以及招募新兵时支付的一次性费用，后者由其{#4}等级{/#4}和装备决定。游戏前期，新成员需要装备，因此采购开支最高。这时适当投入，可以避免之后花费更多。

units.source: {#1}Armor{/#1} is the most difficult item to loot in the early game because low level recruits cannot afford to puncture enemies and get injured or even killed in the process. That's why buying cost effective {#2}Armor{/#2} like {#3}Padded Leather{/#3} with the starting funds is a sound choice.
units.zh: {#1}护甲{/#1}是前期最难缴获的物品，因为低等级新兵承受不起用破甲刺击慢慢对付敌人的风险，很可能因此受伤甚至死亡。所以，用初始资金购买{#3}衬垫皮甲{/#3}等性价比高的{#2}护甲{/#2}是个稳妥选择。

units.source: Later in the game, premium {#1}Character Backgrounds{/#1} like Hedge Knights can be hired. They most often come with high tier {#2}Armor{/#2} and {#3}Weapons{/#3}. Recruiting them means buying equipment.
units.zh: 游戏后期，可以招募流浪骑士等高级{#1}人物背景{/#1}。他们大多自带高级{#2}护甲{/#2}与{#3}武器{/#3}；雇用他们，也相当于购买装备。

units.source: {#1}Weapons{/#1} are easier to get than {#2}Armor{/#2} because hitting the enemy won't damage them. Player Gazomierz gives good advice on that matter:
units.zh: {#1}武器{/#1}比{#2}护甲{/#2}容易获得，因为攻击敌人不会损伤其武器。玩家 Gazomierz 对此有一条实用建议：

units.source: {#1}Another reason not to buy stuff is rather simple, most of it can be looted. You can equip your entire band with mail [armor] and tier[]2 weapons on raiders alone. And that's what you should aim for.{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}2{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}不买装备的另一个理由很简单：大部分都能缴获。光靠打掠夺者，就能让整个战团装备锁甲和 2 阶武器。这正是你该追求的目标。{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}2{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}

units.source: Damaged items have a reduced price. Is it worth it to buy them? In order to know, use the table provided in the {#1}Loot{/#1} section. The higher the Worth per Durability, the more interesting it is.
units.zh: 受损物品的价格更低，值得买吗？可以参考{#1}战利品{/#1}章节中的表格。每点耐久对应的价值越高，就越值得考虑。
除装备外，采购开支还包括{#1}补给{/#1}：

units.source: {#1}Provisions{/#1} are the only vital resource. This item of expenditure cannot really be saved upon or people will get Angry and desert the company. The amount that's needed can only be reduced by dismissing mercenaries or by buying cheaper types of {#2}Provisions{/#2} like Ground Grain.
units.zh: {#1}口粮{/#1}是唯一不可或缺的生存物资。这笔钱基本省不得，否则成员会愤怒并离开战团。要降低需求，只能解雇佣兵，或购买杂粮粉等更便宜的{#2}口粮{/#2}。

units.source: Tools and Supplies can be a major item of expenditure if enemies keep hitting party members and if the player keeps repairing damaged equipment. On that subject, Gazomierz has some insight:
units.zh: 如果队员经常被敌人命中，而玩家又不断修理受损装备，工具与修缮物资就可能成为一笔大开支。Gazomierz 对此也有一些看法：

units.source: {#1}It's not really worth it to repair most of low tier gear as it's just so easy to replace it. Use one weapon, once it brakes switch to the next one.{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}2{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}大多数低级装备都不太值得修，因为替代品太容易找到了。先用一把武器，坏了就换下一把。{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}2{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}

units.source: This can be said for {#1}Armor{/#1} as well once the player feels comfortable enough to get regular replacements from enemies by using {#2}Daggers{/#2} Puncture or {#3}Flails{/#3} Lash skill.
units.zh: 等玩家熟练掌握用{#2}匕首{/#2}的破甲刺击或{#3}连枷{/#3}的鞭打，能稳定从敌人身上取得替换装备后，{#1}护甲{/#1}也可以照此处理。

units.source: {#1}With [armor] it's a bit more tricky. You don't loot as much of it as you loot weapons. But if you have spare suits of low tier [armor] you can do the same thing. Just switch when it gets low. You're aiming at mail anyway, so [until] that just try to minimize [usage] of tools.{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}2{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}护甲稍微麻烦些，因为它的缴获量不如武器。不过，如果你备有几套低级护甲，也可以采用同样的办法：耐久低了就换。反正你的目标是穿上锁甲，在那之前，尽量少用工具就好。{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4}[{/#4}2{#5}]{/#5}{/#3}{/#2}

units.source: Getting hit will not only damage equipment but may also cause {#1}Temporary Injuries{/#1} if enough damage to {#2}Hit Points{/#2} has been dealt. They can only be healed by Medical Supplies. Each day spent healing requires 1 {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}. These {#6}Temporary Injuries{/#6} can really incapacitate a mercenary for a long time, enough that dismissing him could be a safe financial choice.
units.zh: 被命中不只会损坏装备；如果受到足够多的{#2}生命值{/#2}伤害，还可能造成{#1}临时伤势{/#1}。这些伤势只能依靠医疗物资治愈，治疗期间每天需要 1 {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}。{#6}临时伤势{/#6}可能使佣兵长时间无法有效作战，严重时，解雇他甚至可能是更稳妥的经济选择。

units.source: {#1}Temporary Injuries{/#1} and the costs they incur can be avoided by increasing {#2}Hit Points{/#2} on {#3}Level{/#3} up or with {#4}Perks{/#4} like Colossus.
units.zh: {#3}升级{/#3}时提高{#2}生命值{/#2}，或选择巨人体魄等{#4}特长{/#4}，都能降低遭受{#1}临时伤势{/#1}及其相关开支的风险。

units.source: Ammunition expenses can rise up fast if several recruits are using {#1}Bows{/#1} with Quick Shot. It is advised to mostly stick to {#2}Crossbows{/#2} in the early game and slowly switch as the campaign progresses. {#3}Crossbows{/#3} have better aim and use only 1 {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} per attack.
units.zh: 如果多名新兵使用{#1}弓{/#1}施展快速射击，弹药开支会迅速增加。建议前期以{#2}弩{/#2}为主，再随战役推进逐渐调整。{#3}弩{/#3}更容易命中，每次攻击也只消耗 1 {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}。

units.source: Last but not least, {#1}Taverns{/#1} will provide services for a fee. It's usually not worth it in the beginning to pay for those. Drinks will increase {#2}Morale{/#2} but only for a short time until it goes back to normal.
units.zh: 最后，{#1}酒馆{/#1}也会提供收费服务，但前期通常不值得花这个钱。请人喝酒能提高{#2}士气{/#2}，不过效果短暂，很快就会恢复正常。

units.source: Wages can go out of hand quickly if left unchecked. The Roster size, the {#1}Character Backgrounds{/#1} and their {#2}Level{/#2}, the Greedy {#3}Trait{/#3} and related {#4}Events{/#4} define how high the wages will be.
units.zh: 如果不加控制，工资很快就会失控。战团人数、{#1}人物背景{/#1}及{#2}等级{/#2}、贪婪{#3}特性{/#3}和相关{#4}事件{/#4}，都会决定工资高低。

units.source: Only 12 mercenaries can join a battle. So, keeping a count that is close to this number in the early stages of a campaign will do financial wonders. Not only in terms of wages but also in terms of {#1}Provisions{/#1} consumed because each character requires 2 (?) {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} per day.
units.zh: 只有 12 名佣兵能参加战斗。因此，战役初期将人数维持在接近这一规模，能显著改善财务状况。不仅能省工资，也能减少{#1}口粮{/#1}消耗，因为每名角色每天需要 2（？）{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}。

units.source: Always save at least one free spot in your party (unless playing {#1}Lone Wolf{/#1}) in case an event triggers and if not, just to keep hiring new characters and replace the weakest link.
units.zh: 战团里应始终留出至少一个空位，以便接纳事件中加入的人，{#1}孤狼{/#1}起源除外。即使没遇到事件，也可以不断招募新角色，替换队伍中较弱的成员。

units.source: Start with the {#1}backgrounds{/#1} page for base information and answers to questions not examined here such as:
units.zh: 建议先查看{#1}人物背景{/#1}页面，了解基础信息，以及这里未展开讨论的问题，例如：

units.source: What attribute scores can each background get, how do they rate and compare?
units.zh: 每种背景能获得怎样的属性？它们各有什么优势，彼此如何比较？

units.source: Where can I find a specific background?
units.zh: 在哪里能找到特定背景的人？

units.source: Which events are associated with a specific background?
units.zh: 哪些事件与特定背景有关？

units.source: There are two main variables to consider when deciding on whether or not to hire a character:
units.zh: 决定是否雇用一个角色时，主要需要考虑两个因素：

units.source: Other secondary variables influence those. For example, true cost is higher if the equipment the recruit brought is useless and ends up being sold back. The cost is in part recovered if the equipment was to be bought anyway. Likewise, power depends on attribute rolls on level up and talents. But those are random and cannot be used as a basis to make a decision.
units.zh: 其他次要因素也会影响成本与实力。例如，新兵自带的装备如果派不上用场，只能转手卖掉，实际招募成本就更高；如果本来就打算买这些装备，招募费用便可视为部分抵消了装备开支。同样，实力也取决于升级时的属性随机值和天赋，但这些是随机的，无法在招募前据此作决定。

units.source: That said, specific {#1}traits{/#1} and {#2}talents{/#2} can be excluded for a particular background. These exclusions are not listed in full here but usually, trait quality is correlated to cost. One trait can be guessed through a given {#3}title{/#3} (but having an eligible trait doesn't necessarily give a title). All possessed traits can be revealed for a fee with the try-out option (see the {#4}Should I try a recruit out?{/#4} section).
units.zh: 不过，有些背景不会出现特定的{#1}特性{/#1}或{#2}天赋{/#2}。这里不逐一列出这些限制；通常，特性质量与价格有关。有时可以通过{#3}称号{/#3}推测某项特性，但具有相关特性不一定就会获得称号。付费试用可以揭示新兵的全部特性，详见{#4}应该先试用新兵吗？{/#4}。

units.source: Depending on the game stage, settings and play style, desired value ranges and ratios for these variables change. But as a rule, it’s obviously better to look for the most power for the cost. The most powerful backgrounds have an unfavorable ratio. Several good backgrounds have a favorable ratio while many average or poor backgrounds have an unfavorable ratio. Knowing what each offer for the price is therefore an excellent way to get better results.
units.zh: 游戏阶段、设置和玩法不同，对这些数值与比例的需求也会变化。但一般而言，同样的成本当然应尽量换来更强的实力。最强的背景通常性价比较低；有些不错的背景性价比很高，而不少中等或较弱背景的性价比反而不佳。因此，弄清每种背景的价格能换来什么，能显著改善招募效果。

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}How is a recruit hiring cost calculated?{/#3}{/#2}
The hiring cost depends on several variables:
units.zh: 招募费用由以下因素决定：

units.source: The background defines a base hiring cost going from 30 for the worst ones up to around 150 for the best ones. Swordmasters are an exception with a base cost of 400!
units.zh: 背景决定基础招募费用：最差的背景为 30，最好的背景约为 150。剑术大师是个例外，基础费用高达 400！

units.source: The cost of equipment is set at 1.25 its base value. It is on the high side if compared to settlement prices. Levels are valued thus: 500 x (level – 1) ^ 1.5. With a possible range of 1 to 5, the additional cost goes from 0 to 3,000.
units.zh: 装备费用按基础价值的 1.25 倍计算，与定居点售价相比偏高。等级费用按以下公式计算：500 x（等级 – 1）^ 1.5。由于可招募者等级介于 1 至 5 之间，额外费用范围为 0 至 3,000。

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}How is a recruit daily wages calculated?{/#3}{/#2}
Upkeep depends on the following variables:
For levels, a distinction must be made between:
units.zh: 计算等级因素时，需要区分：

units.source: Each background has a base daily cost which ranges from 3 to 35.
units.zh: 每种背景都有基础日薪，范围为 3 至 35。

units.source: This base value is multiplied by a random number between 90% and 110%.
units.zh: 基础值先乘以一个介于 90% 和 110% 之间的随机倍率。

units.source: The result is then multiplied by 1.1 ^ (level – 1) for the first 11 levels (1 to 2.6 multiplier). Additional levels follow another, less costly formula. The cost of 11 levels is taken as a base and multiplied by 1.03 ^ (level – 11). For example, a level 11 Hedge Knight costs, with no other modifiers, 91. And on level 21, he costs 122 in daily upkeep.
units.zh: 前 11 级再乘以 1.1 ^（等级 – 1），对应倍率从 1 到 2.6。之后的等级采用另一套增长较慢的公式：以 11 级时的工资为基础，再乘以 1.03 ^（等级 – 11）。例如，不计其他修正，一名 11 级流浪骑士的日薪为 91；到 21 级时，日薪为 122。

units.source: The player character (Lone Wolf origin) doesn’t need any wages.
units.zh: 孤狼起源的玩家角色不需要工资。

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}Should I recruit backgrounds to fit a role or make with what I get?{/#3}{/#2}

This question summarizes two approaches to recruiting. {#1}Backgrounds{/#1} each have strengths and weaknesses. For example, a {#2}Deserter{/#2} will never get outstanding Resolve. Therefore, limiting negative Resolve checks (mostly from being surrounded) and positioning him in the back line is probably a good idea. But if the team is already lacking people to hold the front hiring a low Resolve background is probably not a good idea. However, if the recruit is at a discount why not just roll with it and adapt your team around it, especially if it's a great hire?
units.zh: 这个问题概括了两种招募思路。每种{#1}背景{/#1}都有长处和短板。例如，{#2}逃兵{/#2}不可能拥有出色的意志，因此减少他承受的不利意志检定，尤其是避免被包围，并把他放在后排，可能是不错的办法。但如果队伍已经缺乏能顶住前排的人，招募低意志背景就未必合适。反过来说，若新兵价格优惠，为何不顺势调整队伍来适应他？尤其当他确实是个好苗子时。

units.source: Both approaches can be combined. Sometimes, they naturally are. For example, {#1}Thieves{/#1} have a high base Initiative and Defenses and make great candidates for the Dodge {#2}perk{/#2} and generally swift, nimble front builds. At the same time, they have an excellent power per cost ratio and for that reason are almost always worth hiring.
units.zh: 两种思路可以结合，有时它们本来就会自然重合。例如，{#1}盗贼{/#1}的基础先攻和防御较高，很适合选择闪避{#2}特长{/#2}，通常也适合快速、灵巧的前排培养方案。同时，他们的实力与成本之比非常出色，因此几乎总值得招募。

units.source: These matters will be covered in more details in the builds section. The following sections are orientated towards an aggressive hire and dismiss style.
units.zh: 培养方案章节会更详细地讨论这些问题。以下内容则侧重于频繁招募、淘汰不合适人选的玩法。

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}Which are the most cost-effective backgrounds for hire?{/#3}{/#2}
These are the backgrounds that offer the most stats and potential for the money:
units.zh: 以下背景能用较少的钱，换来较高的属性和潜力：

units.source: Best possible bargain but base upkeep was increased to 13 to reflect that
units.zh: 可能是最划算的选择，但为反映其价值，基础日薪已提高至 13

units.source: Cannot get a talent in Ranged Skill
units.zh: 不会获得远程命中天赋

units.source: Highest possible base Fatigue and very high base Hitpoints (like Farmhands but with much better Resolve)
units.zh: 可拥有最高的基础疲劳上限，基础生命值也极高，类似农场帮工，但意志好得多

units.source: Some of the worst Defense scores
units.zh: 防御属性属于最差的一档
防御属性与佣兵背景相当

units.source: Second best base Initiative of hirable backgrounds
units.zh: 基础先攻在可招募背景中位居第二

units.source: Another set of backgrounds with slightly lower ratios rounds up the list:
units.zh: 以下几种背景的性价比稍低一些，但也值得列入考虑：

units.source: Well-rounded stats (versatile) and high base Melee Skill
units.zh: 属性均衡，适应多种定位，基础近战命中较高

units.source: Very high base Fatigue and Hitpoints
units.zh: 基础疲劳上限与生命值都很高

units.source: Less powerful but cannot get a talent in Ranged Skill
units.zh: 实力稍弱，但不会获得远程命中天赋

units.source: These last backgrounds do not have as much potential but they can still be cheap:
units.zh: 最后这些背景的潜力较低，但仍可能很便宜：

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}Which are the most powerful backgrounds for hire?{/#3}{/#2}
Cost aside, these backgrounds are the most powerful. They are mostly free from bad traits.
units.zh: 不考虑价格时，以下背景实力最强，而且基本不会出现负面特性。

units.source: Great attribute scores everywhere it matters
units.zh: 各项重要属性都很出色

units.source: Cannot get talents in Initiative or Ranged Skill
units.zh: 不会获得先攻或远程命中天赋

units.source: Usually very expensive but the equipment can be useful
units.zh: 通常很贵，但自带装备可能很有用

units.source: Well balanced stats and fit for any role
units.zh: 属性均衡，能适应任何定位

units.source: Easy to find and can be cheap to recruit
units.zh: 容易找到，招募价格也可能较低

units.source: Good attribute scores everywhere it matters

units.zh: 可拥有最高的基础意志
与其实力相比，日薪较低
可拥有最高的基础远程命中

units.source: A last background to consider is {#1}Swordmaster{/#1}. Swordmasters eventually get the Old trait and lose on core attributes but the WotN DLC introduced a legendary item to remove it. Hiring one is then recommended even though finding a cheap Swordmaster can prove difficult. Swordmasters have the highest starting Melee Skill and Defense of all backgrounds so they’re guaranteed to perform well in combat. They cannot get a talent in Ranged Skill.
units.zh: 还有一个值得考虑的背景是{#1}剑术大师{/#1}。剑术大师最终会获得年迈特性，损失一些核心属性，但“北境勇士”DLC 加入了一件能移除该特性的传奇物品。因此，建议招募一人，尽管要找到便宜的剑术大师并不容易。剑术大师在所有背景中拥有最高的初始近战命中和近战防御，战斗表现因此有保障。他们不会获得远程命中天赋。

units.source: The try-out option reveals a recruit {#1}traits{/#1} for a fee of whichever is lowest between:
units.zh: 试用可以揭示新兵的{#1}特性{/#1}，费用取以下两项中较低的一项：

units.source: To simplify, for most recruits (hiring cost > 55), this fee is roughly 10% of the hiring cost (see the {#1}Cost and power{/#1} section for information about what's included in this cost).
units.zh: 简单来说，对大多数新兵（招募费用 > 55），试用费约为招募费用的 10%。关于招募费用包含哪些项目，参见{#1}成本与实力{/#1}。

units.source: Try-out reveals one part of the recruit power equation. Whether or not it ends up mattering depends on what traits the recruit got (0 to 2). Since {#1}attribute{/#1} rolls and {#2}talents{/#2} are a big part of the equation the value of this option is at the very least problematic. It should mostly be used to find great traits and to avoid bad ones on average or cheap backgrounds when a strong team has already been built. The idea being that new recruits of lesser backgrounds would need all of traits, attributes and talents to take the spot of a veteran. Premium backgrounds cannot usually get bad traits which further limits the usefulness of trying them out.
units.zh: 试用只揭示新兵实力的一部分，是否有价值取决于他拥有怎样的特性，数量可能为 0 至 2 项。由于{#1}属性{/#1}随机值和{#2}天赋{/#2}也占很大比重，试用的价值至少值得商榷。它更适合在已有强大战团后，用于筛选中等或廉价背景，寻找优秀特性并避开负面特性。这是因为，较弱背景的新兵若想替换老兵，特性、属性和天赋都得足够好。高级背景通常不会出现负面特性，因此试用他们的意义更小。

units.source: Try-out can also be used when lacking the money to hire all desired recruits.
units.zh: 如果资金不足以雇下所有想要的人选，也可以先使用试用。

units.source: {#1}Named items{/#1} are stronger versions of the best normal weapons, armors and shields. All parameters (except Vision and Range) can be improved and new ones added but which ones are and with what values will determine how good and influential the named item is.
units.zh: {#1}红装{/#1}是最好的普通武器、护甲和盾牌的强化版本。除视野与射程外，各项参数都可能提高，也可能增加新的参数；究竟强化了哪些属性、强化到什么程度，决定了这件红装的价值与作用。

units.source: There are currently four main sources to acquire them from:
units.zh: 目前主要有四种获取来源：

units.source: {#1}{#2/}{/#1}

source_exception.reason: 原版快照已经含有同一受保护图片及其来源链接，后面转义的HTML只是在重复显示图片序列化代码；保留真实图片与属性，仅删除重复代码文字。

units.source: A location with two named items
units.zh: 一个藏有两件红装的据点

units.source: Up to two {#1}named items{/#1} can be found in a same location and retrieved after destroying it. The chance for a location to hold named items increases with the location:
units.zh: 同一个据点最多可藏有两件{#1}红装{/#1}，摧毁据点后即可获得。据点拥有红装的概率会随以下因素提高：

units.source: Huge camps built far from civilization are most likely to contain a named item. The chances can range from 0% (and even negative numbers!) to 60% or more. The exact numbers are displayed in the log (...\Documents\Battle Brothers) when a location spawns on the map.
units.zh: 远离文明、规模庞大的营地最可能藏有红装。概率可以从 0%（甚至负数！）到 60% 或更高。据点在地图上生成时，具体数值会记录在日志中，位置为 ...\Documents\Battle Brothers。

units.source: {#1}Contracts{/#1} to destroy a location with{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}and {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} ratings remove the named items they may contain. There are a few exceptions to this rule but it's generally safer to avoid taking anything less than a {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} contract if the location to be destroyed is likely to contain a named item.
units.zh: 难度评级为{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}和 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} 的摧毁据点{#1}委托{/#1}，会移除据点中原有的红装。虽然有少数例外，但如果目标据点很可能藏有红装，通常最好避免接取难度低于 {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} 的委托。

units.source: {#1}Tavern Rumors{/#1} can point to locations with a named item. They will give out hints about the type of item that can be found there as well as the kind of enemies that occupy it. And they will give a general direction by which to find the location. The rumor doesn't add a new named item to the location but simply reveals it.
units.zh: {#1}酒馆传闻{/#1}可能指向藏有红装的据点。传闻会提示物品种类、占据据点的敌人类型，以及寻找该据点的大致方向。传闻不会凭空添加一件红装，只会揭示本就存在的物品。

units.source: Named items belonging to a faction can only be found in locations and on champions of that faction.
units.zh: 阵营专属红装只能在该阵营的据点或冠军敌人身上找到。

units.source: Generated map layouts are stored in map seeds. Starting a new campaign with a same map seed will always generate the same map including locations and their named items (unless the save structure is modified by mods).
units.zh: 生成的地图布局保存在地图种子中。使用同一个地图种子开始新战役，会生成相同的地图，包括据点及其中的红装，除非 MOD 改变了存档结构。

units.source: {#1}{#2/}{/#1}

source_exception.reason: 原版快照已经含有同一受保护图片及其来源链接，后面转义的HTML只是在重复显示图片序列化代码；保留真实图片与属性，仅删除重复代码文字。

units.zh: 一名冠军级地精伏击手

units.source: {#1}Champions{/#1} are to common enemies what {#2}named items{/#2} are to normal items. They always carry one named item randomly selected among a custom list that reflects their faction or their preferences.
units.zh: {#1}冠军敌人{/#1}与普通敌人的关系，就像{#2}红装{/#2}与普通物品的关系。冠军总会携带一件红装，从符合其阵营或偏好的专属列表中随机选择。

units.source: Only top tier enemies can become champions (excluding {#1}Goblins{/#1}) and each of them has a set chance of becoming one. But that chance can be modified by:
units.zh: 除{#1}地精{/#1}外，只有最高阶敌人能成为冠军，各类敌人都有固定的基础出现概率。不过，以下因素可以改变概率：

units.source: Since most champions get a base 1% chance it's quite difficult to see many if not any before day 101. Contracts of {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} difficulty against Goblins are most likely to generate at least one champion and probably more given how common {#4}skirmishers{/#4} and {#5}ambushers{/#5} are.
units.zh: 大多数敌人成为冠军的基础概率只有 1%，因此在第 101 天之前，冠军不仅少见，有时甚至根本不会出现。针对地精、难度为 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} 的委托最可能生成至少一名冠军；考虑到{#4}地精游击兵{/#4}和{#5}地精伏击手{/#5}很常见，也可能出现更多。

units.source: {#1}{#2/}{/#1}

source_exception.reason: 原版快照已经含有同一受保护图片及其来源链接，后面转义的HTML只是在重复显示图片序列化代码；保留真实图片与属性，仅删除重复代码文字。

units.source: A shop with five named items
units.zh: 一家出售五件红装的商店

units.source: All {#1}shops{/#1} excluding the {#2}market{/#2} have a slight chance to sell a number of {#3}named items{/#3} for a limited period of time which can extend to 3 days before the shop replenishes its stock or gets forcibly restocked by a {#4}settlement situation{/#4}.
units.zh: 除{#2}市场{/#2}外，所有{#1}商店{/#1}都有小概率在有限时间内出售一些{#3}红装{/#3}。这些商品最多保留 3 天，直到商店补货，或被某种{#4}当地状况{/#4}强制刷新库存。

units.source: The following shops will sell named items that are not restricted to a {#1}faction{/#1}:
units.zh: 以下商店会出售不受{#1}阵营{/#1}限制的红装：

units.source: {#1}Armorer{/#1}: all {#2}named armors{/#2} and {#3}named helmets{/#3} (excluding the Lindwurm set)
units.zh: {#1}制甲师{/#1}：所有{#2}红装身体护甲{/#2}和{#3}红装头盔{/#3}，林德蠕龙套装除外

units.source: So shops have more or less named item types to offer. Each type has a chance to be selected for another check that will determine if it is available for sale. Each type rolls for selection according to its shop:
units.zh: 因此，不同商店可提供的红装种类数量不同。每一种类先进行筛选判定，被选中后再作一次判定，决定是否上架。各商店的种类筛选概率如下：

units.source: This ensures some balance in what is offered between all item categories.
units.zh: 这使不同物品类别的供应保持一定平衡。

units.source: After that, each selected item rolls for availability. The base rarity for a named item type is 1%. Three 0-100 rolls are made and checked against the rarity. The rolls range is modified by settlement situations. Positive situations can increase the range and the likelihood that shops will offer more (named) items. These are:
units.zh: 接着，每件被选中的物品都会进行上架判定。每类红装的基础稀有度为 1%。系统会进行三次 0-100 范围内的随机判定，并与稀有度比较。当地状况会调整随机数范围。正面状况可以扩大范围，提高商店出售更多物品，包括红装的可能性。这些状况包括：

units.source: On the contrary, several negative situations decrease the range and almost always prevent named items from appearing in shops at all.
units.zh: 相反，多种负面状况会缩小范围，几乎让商店完全无法出现红装。

units.source: Some {#1}events{/#1} can reward {#2}named items{/#2}. See their respective page for details:
units.zh: 有些{#1}事件{/#1}会奖励{#2}红装{/#2}，详情参见对应页面：

units.source: A {#1}Historian{/#1} is needed for the item to be named (a {#2}named shield{/#2}). All types but the Orc and Undead kind can be acquired.
units.zh: 需要一名{#1}历史学者{/#1}，奖励才会变成红装，即一面{#2}红装盾牌{/#2}。除兽人和亡灵款式外，其他种类都可能获得。

units.source: {#1}Shady Character Offers Map{/#1} (reveals a location containing a named item)
units.zh: {#1}可疑人物兜售地图{/#1}（揭示一个藏有红装的据点）

units.source: Without a {#1}Historian{/#1} the map will not always be readable.
units.zh: 没有{#1}历史学者{/#1}时，不一定能看懂地图。

units.source: Depending on dialog choices, it will either reward a {#1}named axe{/#1}, a {#2}named spear{/#2}, a {#3}wolf helmet{/#3} or a {#4}hardened leather armor{/#4}.
Depending on dialog choices, it will reward a {#1}named dagger{/#1} with a 1 in 6 chance.
units.zh: 根据对话选择，有 1/6 的概率获得一把{#1}红装匕首{/#1}。

units.source: Depending on dialog choices, it will either reward a {#1}named dagger{/#1}, a {#2}studded mail armor{/#2} or a {#3}named greatsword{/#3}.
units.zh: 根据对话选择，会奖励{#1}红装匕首{/#1}、{#2}铆钉锁甲{/#2}或{#3}红装巨剑{/#3}中的一种。

units.source: To gain a named qatal dagger you need a {#1}Belly Dancer{/#1}.
units.zh: 要获得红装卡塔尔匕首，需要一名{#1}肚皮舞者{/#1}。

units.source: To gain a named crossbow you need a {#1}Witchhunter{/#1}
units.zh: 要获得红装弩，需要一名{#1}猎巫人{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Changing Sides{/#1} (random named item among a limited list)
units.zh: {#1}倒戈{/#1}（从限定列表中随机获得一件红装）

units.source: {#1}Merchant in Distress{/#1} (can reveal an Undead location containing a named item)
units.zh: {#1}遇险商人{/#1}（可能揭示一个藏有红装的亡灵据点）

units.source: {#1}Spartacus{/#1} (can reveal an Undead location containing a named item)
units.zh: {#1}斯巴达克斯{/#1}（可能揭示一个藏有红装的亡灵据点）

units.source: Battle Brothers is as much combat tactics than company management. While traveling on the worldmap, strategic decisions must be made that will affect the progression of the team and the type and difficulty of the next encounters.
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》既重视战斗战术，也重视战团管理。在世界地图上旅行时，你需要作出战略决策；这些决策会影响队伍成长，以及接下来遭遇的类型与难度。

units.source: {#1}Ambitions{/#1} are the most efficient way to improve {#2}renown{/#2} in the early game. Since {#3}contract{/#3} payment increases with renown (see {#4}How much do [contracts] pay?{/#4}), taking and fulfilling ambitions should be a priority. Normally, each ambition can only be completed once.
units.zh: {#1}战团抱负{/#1}是前期提高{#2}声望{/#2}最有效的途径。{#3}委托{/#3}报酬会随声望增加，详见{#4}委托报酬有多少？{/#4}，因此应优先选择并完成战团抱负。通常，每项战团抱负只能完成一次。

units.source: {#1}{/#1}{#2}{#3}What ambition should I pick in the early game?{/#3}{/#2}

Carefully choosing ambitions will help chain them and rake in {#1}renown{/#1}. Some ambitions can be completed at all times while others will be locked if their conditions were met before they were offered and selected. Deciding on what ambition to take thus depends on several factors. Predicting what's likely to occur and when is key to making the right decision.
units.zh: 仔细安排战团抱负，可以接连完成它们，积累大量{#1}声望{/#1}。有些战团抱负随时都能完成；另一些如果在出现并被选中之前，条件就已达成，之后便不会再出现。因此，选择哪项战团抱负取决于多种因素，判断接下来可能发生什么、何时发生，是作出正确选择的关键。

units.source: The goal of early game ambitions is not only to increase renown but to unlock noble {#1}contracts{/#1} with the Reach 'Professional' Renown ambition. The following is a suggestion on what ambition to choose and in what order to reach that point as quickly as possible.
units.zh: 前期完成战团抱负，不只是为了提高声望，也是为了通过“达到专业声望”这一战团抱负解锁贵族{#1}委托{/#1}。以下是一套建议顺序，帮助你尽快达到这个目标。

units.source: Get to 'Friendly' relations with a civilian faction
units.zh: 与一个平民阵营达到“友好”关系

units.source: Have a roster of at least 12 men

units.zh: 拥有至少 2,000 克朗（战旗）

units.source: Discover a ruin or hostile camp, and destroy it
units.zh: 发现一处遗迹或敌对营地，并将其摧毁

units.source: Have one man with the 'Rally the Troops' perk
units.zh: 让一名成员拥有“重振士气”特长

units.source: Win a battle against 12 or more enemies
units.zh: 赢得一场对抗至少 12 名敌人的战斗

units.source: The Visit All Settlements ambition was intentionally left out because there's almost always at least one settlement that is very hard to reach and to do so would waste precious time and resources. In case it were not, the ambition could be selected at any point.
units.zh: 这里有意略去了“拜访所有定居点”战团抱负，因为地图上几乎总有至少一个定居点非常难抵达，前往那里会浪费宝贵的时间与资源。如果你的地图没有这种情况，则可以在任意阶段选择该战团抱负。
建议的战团抱负选择顺序

units.source: 1° Get to 'Friendly' relations with a civilian faction
units.zh: 1° 与一个平民阵营达到“友好”关系

units.source: Probably the easiest ambition to complete. And since it does have a locking condition, it should be taken first. The Peasant Militia {#1}origin{/#1} starts with a friendly town so it cannot take this ambition. Friendly means a relations rating ≥ 70. Each successfully completed contract gives +10 relations with the settlement (base is 50). Note that negotiating contracts can decrease relations (see {#2}Should I negotiate for better payment?{/#2}).
units.zh: 这可能是最容易完成的战团抱负，而且存在无法再选择它的条件，因此应优先接取。农民民兵{#1}起源{/#1}开局就与一座城镇友好，所以无法选择此战团抱负。“友好”要求关系值 ≥ 70。每次成功完成委托，与当地定居点的关系都会 +10，基础关系为 50。注意，委托谈判可能降低关系，详见{#2}该不该谈判争取更高报酬？{/#2}。
已与一座定居点达到友好关系

units.source: 2° Have a roster of at least 12 men

Debatable as a second because some players intentionally keep a small roster to reduce contract difficulty (see {#1}What influences contract difficulty?{/#1}). That said, going to 12 as soon as possible will fasten progression (experience, equipment and monetary gains). The ambition will be locked if the roster already has 12 men so be sure to stay under that number to access this ambition. The Peasant Militia origin doesn't get this ambition but another with a 16 men requirement.
units.zh: 将其排在第二位有争议，因为有些玩家会刻意维持小队规模，以降低委托难度，详见{#1}哪些因素影响委托难度？{/#1}。不过，尽快扩充到 12 人会加快经验、装备与资金的积累。战团已有 12 人时，这项战团抱负就不会出现，所以想接到它，必须暂时保持低于这个人数。农民民兵起源不会获得此战团抱负，而是获得另一项要求 16 人的战团抱负。
战团已有 12 人{#1/}农民民兵起源
3° 拥有至少 2,000 克朗（战旗）

units.source: This ambition is not only easy to fulfill it's also very useful in the early game because it rewards the {#1}Battle Standard{/#1}, a slightly weaker {#2}Pike{/#2} with a Resolve aura. Note that due to how ambitions are processed, there could be a delay between the fulfillment of the conditions and the actual completion of the ambition. This can be problematic because of wages and in the case of relations because of their daily decay. Camping will sometimes reduce the delays. Alternatively, a fix can be downloaded{#3}{#4}{#5}[{/#5}3{#6}]{/#6}{/#4}{/#3}. The actual cost for the Battle Standard is 1,000 crowns. Make sure to have a free inventory slot or the ambition won't complete! Seemingly, if the Standard is lost, the ambition can be taken again.
units.zh: 这项战团抱负不但容易完成，前期也很实用，因为它会奖励{#1}战旗{/#1}：一种略弱于{#2}长枪{/#2}、但带有意志光环的武器。注意，由于战团抱负的处理方式，达成条件与实际完成之间可能存在延迟。工资支出可能让资金重新不足，关系每日衰减也可能让关系条件重新不满足。有时扎营可以缩短延迟，也可以下载一个修复补丁{#3}{#4}{#5}[{/#5}3{#6}]{/#6}{/#4}{/#3}。战旗实际花费为 1,000 克朗。务必留出一个空物品栏位，否则战团抱负无法完成！看起来，如果战旗丢失，这项战团抱负还能再次接取。

units.source: 4° Discover a ruin or hostile camp, and destroy it
units.zh: 4° 发现一处遗迹或敌对营地，并将其摧毁

units.source: This one is harder because finding camps that can be destroyed early on is tricky. But it should still be taken fairly early because it has a locking condition. Brigand and Undead camps would be likely targets though fighting more than 12 enemies would lock the ambition to do so. Location destroyed under contract do not count towards the fulfillment of the ambition. But you can combine it with the Discover Location {#1}contract{/#1}.

units.source: Finding 12 or more enemy groups outside of camps can prove difficult in the early game. The most probable target would be an Undead camp filled with {#1}Wiedergangers{/#1}. units.source: This is the final goal of the early game ambitions. The one that will unlock a score of other ambitions to choose from later. How close you are to the Professional level will depend on what origin you chose and on the number of contracts and battles you completed. Origins may start with as low as −100 renown or with a positive 200 renown. The Trading Carvan earns only half renown. Six completed ambitions will give out 600 renown. Failing at or cancelling contracts and ambitions, losing battles and retreating will reduce renown.

units.source: This is another table with expected {#1}attributes{/#1} scores. The last column is a custom made rating that shows how much more points a Background gets from average scores (Apprentice). Every attribute is accounted for and weighed according to its level-up range, {#2}the sum of each ([attribute average difference from Apprentice] ÷ [level-up range at 0 stars] ÷ [3, the number of upgrades per level-up]), rounded to 2 decimal places.{/#2} Thus, it represents roughly the number of attribute level-ups better that a Background is, compared to Apprentice. {#3}To see another version of the "Rating" column, refer to {#4}the previous page version{/#4}.{/#3}
units.zh: 下表列出各背景的预期{#1}属性{/#1}。最后一列是自定义评分，衡量该背景相较于基准背景（学徒）的平均属性优势。计算时纳入全部属性，并按各属性的升级增幅加权：{#2}将每项属性的［平均值与学徒的差］÷［0 星时的升级增幅］÷［3，即每次升级可提升的属性数］相加，结果保留 2 位小数。{/#2}因此，这个评分大致表示该背景相较学徒多出了多少次升级的属性收益。{#3}如需查看另一种“评分”算法，请参阅{#4}此页的旧版本{/#4}。{/#3}

{#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}{#4}Attachments (when not destroyed), buildings and situations add additional entries to the list of character backgrounds from which new recruits are randomly chosen. +1 means that the chance to see such characters available for recruitment was increased by roughly 2-3%/3-5%/6-8,5% for large/medium/small settlements respectively. +2 means 2 times that increase etc.{/#4}{/#3}
units.zh: {#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}{#4}附属设施（未被摧毁时）、建筑和当地状况会向人物背景候选列表添加额外条目，新兵的背景会从该列表中随机抽取。+1 表示在大型／中型／小型聚落中，出现此类新兵的几率分别约增加 2-3%／3-5%／6-8,5%。+2 表示增幅为其 2 倍，以此类推。{/#4}{/#3}
